cond_0001.intro: The Data Science Manager will manage a team of statisticians in research and development of new predictive models and new analytical techniques related to insurance pure premiums, customer lifetime value, customer buying behaviors and related topics using internal and external data.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Provide analytics for setting price, underwriting and products strategies. Implement analysis and modeling tests. Develop and enhance models used in a variety of contexts within the product management structure. Advance modeling capabilities. Work with colleagues in various departments to facilitate the application of models developed considering the regulatory and competitive contexts. Ensure models are understood, implications are appropriately assessed, implementation plans are defined, validation of results are undertaken and adjustments are made. Supervise, manage and develop assigned staff.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or related field (willing to accept foreign education equivalent) and a minimum of seven (7) years' experience supervising predictive/advanced analytics.
Alternatively, will accept Ph.D. And five years' experience in supervising predictive/advanced analytics.
Demonstrated expertise in SAS, R, or Python.
Demonstrated expertise in Bayesian statistics.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated experience in developing multivariate predictive models in an insurance/financial fields.

cond_0085.responsibilities: Provide analytics for setting price, underwriting and products strategies. Implement analysis and modeling tests. Develop and enhance models used in a variety of contexts within the product management structure. Advance modeling capabilities. Work with colleagues in various departments to facilitate the application of models developed considering the regulatory and competitive contexts. Ensure models are understood, implications are appropriately assessed, implementation plans are defined, validation of results are undertaken and adjustments are made. Supervise, manage and develop assigned staff.
cond_0085.requirements:
Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or related field (willing to accept foreign education equivalent) and a minimum of seven (7) years' experience supervising predictive/advanced analytics.
Alternatively, will accept Ph.D. And five years' experience in supervising predictive/advanced analytics.
Demonstrated expertise in SAS, R, or Python etc.
Demonstrated expertise in Bayesian statistics.
Demonstrated experience in developing multivariate predictive models in an insurance/financial fields.
cond_0085.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

A large part of this role involves staying in regular contact with colleagues across departments to facilitate the application of predictive models within the product management structure. You will actively contribute to discussions around regulatory and competitive contexts, walk stakeholders through model implications, and help clarify implementation plans.
Provide analytics for setting price, underwriting and products strategies. Implement analysis and modeling tests. Develop and enhance models used in a variety of contexts within the product management structure. Advance modeling capabilities. Ensure models are understood, implications are appropriately assessed, implementation plans are defined, validation of results are undertaken and adjustments are made. Supervise, manage and develop assigned staff.
cond_0330.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or related field (willing to accept foreign education equivalent) and a minimum of seven (7) years' experience supervising predictive/advanced analytics, or a Ph.D. And five years' experience supervising predictive/advanced analytics.
Demonstrated expertise in SAS, R, or Python.
Demonstrated experience in developing multivariate predictive models in an insurance/financial field.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated expertise in Bayesian statistics.
cond_0330.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Work alongside statisticians in research and development of new predictive models and analytical techniques related to insurance pure premiums, customer lifetime value, customer buying behaviors, and related topics using internal and external data.
Coordinate with colleagues to provide analytics for setting price, underwriting, and product strategies. Support the implementation of analysis and modeling tests. Collaborate on developing and enhancing models used across the product management structure. Help advance modeling capabilities. Work with colleagues in various departments to facilitate the application of models, taking into account regulatory and competitive contexts. Help ensure models are understood, implications are appropriately assessed, implementation plans are defined, validation of results is undertaken, and adjustments are made. Supervise, manage, and develop assigned staff.
cond_0567.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field (willing to accept foreign education equivalent) with at least 7 years of experience supervising predictive/advanced analytics, or a Ph.D. With at least 5 years of experience supervising predictive/advanced analytics.
Demonstrated expertise in SAS, R, or Python.
Demonstrated experience developing multivariate predictive models in insurance or financial fields.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated expertise in Bayesian statistics.
cond_0567.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.
